change_control.review_note: Portugal ruleset verified against the official Embassy Working Holiday page and current Embassy visa procedure page.

summary_facts.label: Residence
summary_facts.value: Portuguese citizen resident in Portugal at application

summary_facts.label: Funds baseline
summary_facts.value: €7,000 with a purchased return ticket; €8,000 without one

summary_facts.label: Application route
summary_facts.value: In person at the Embassy of Japan in Lisbon by prior appointment

eligibility_rules.label: Are you a Portuguese citizen?
eligibility_rules.fail_message: This Working Holiday route is for Portuguese citizens.

eligibility_rules.label: Are you resident in Portugal at the time of application?
eligibility_rules.fail_message: Portuguese Working Holiday applicants must reside in Portugal when applying.

eligibility_rules.label: Your age at the time you expect to apply
eligibility_rules.fail_message: The Portuguese Working Holiday age range is 18–30 inclusive at application.

eligibility_rules.label: Is your primary purpose to holiday in Japan?
eligibility_rules.fail_message: The Portuguese programme is for an extended holiday; it is not intended for full-time work or academic study.

eligibility_rules.label: Will dependants without their own eligible status accompany you?
eligibility_rules.fail_message: Dependants may only accompany you if they independently hold an appropriate Japanese status.

eligibility_rules.label: Can you truthfully meet the good-health and no-criminal-record requirements?
eligibility_rules.fail_message: The programme requires good health and no criminal record.

funds_rule.input_label: Funds shown in your Portuguese bank statements (€)

jurisdiction.label: Embassy of Japan in Portugal — Lisbon
jurisdiction.description: Working Holiday applications are submitted personally to the Embassy in Lisbon. The current general visa page says applicants must make an appointment by phone or email before applying.
jurisdiction.ui_help: Portuguese applicants must reside in Portugal and use the Embassy in Lisbon.

options.label: I am resident in Portugal
options.mission_label: Embassy of Japan in Portugal — Lisbon
options.mission_detail: Apply personally at the Embassy in Lisbon after arranging an appointment under the current visa procedure.

options.label: I am not resident in Portugal
options.mission_label: Portuguese Working Holiday route may not apply
options.mission_detail: The programme requires Portuguese citizenship and residence in Portugal at application.
options.issue: The Portugal Working Holiday route requires the applicant to be a Portuguese citizen resident in Portugal at the time of application.

document_checklist.title: Valid Portuguese passport
document_checklist.description: Passport should have available visa pages and at least 12 months validity under the current Working Holiday guidance.

document_checklist.title: Completed and signed visa application form
document_checklist.description: Prepare the current application form with the applicant's signature.

document_checklist.title: Recent photograph
document_checklist.description: 45mm × 35mm photograph taken within the previous six months.

document_checklist.title: Curriculum Vitae
document_checklist.description: Prepare the current Working Holiday CV form.

document_checklist.title: Itinerary / activity plan
document_checklist.description: Prepare the official stay/activity outline for the planned period in Japan.

document_checklist.title: A4 motivation statement
document_checklist.description: Explain the reasons for requesting the Working Holiday visa.

document_checklist.title: Return ticket / reservation or extra funds
document_checklist.description: Provide the return ticket or booking, or enough additional funds to acquire the return travel.

document_checklist.title: Three months of bank statements
document_checklist.description: Current guidance requires at least €8,000, or €7,000 where the return ticket has been acquired.

document_checklist.title: Medical certificate
document_checklist.description: Provide the medical certificate requested by the current Working Holiday checklist.

document_checklist.title: International health insurance or National Health Insurance pledge
document_checklist.description: Provide qualifying international health coverage for the authorised stay or the permitted pledge to join Japan's National Health Insurance.

preparation_checklist.title: Book the Lisbon Embassy appointment
preparation_checklist.description: Current general visa guidance requires an appointment by phone or email before lodging.

preparation_checklist.title: Match funds to return-ticket position
preparation_checklist.description: Use the €7,000 threshold only where the return ticket has been acquired; otherwise use the €8,000 baseline.

preparation_checklist.title: Plan for personal submission
preparation_checklist.description: The Working Holiday application must be submitted by the applicant; family, travel agency and postal applications are not accepted.

preparation_checklist.title: Run a final official-source check
preparation_checklist.description: Recheck the Embassy Working Holiday and visa procedure pages before applying.
